question_text: A local government unit (LGU) passes an ordinance requiring all women to undergo a mandatory medical examination before they can be employed in any private company within its jurisdiction. Which provision of RA 9710 (Magna Carta of Women) does this ordinance violate?

options.text: The right to equal access to employment and livelihood, which prohibits discriminatory pre-employment requirements.
The right to health, which mandates that women must undergo regular check-ups.
The right to political participation, which requires women to be involved in local legislation.
The right to education, which ensures women have access to training programs.
